messages:
sam-acme: Hey, overnight our trial credits dropped ~14k tokens. We only run a nightly rerank job, nothing else changed. Can you check?
monitoring-bot: Alert: unusual-token-usage spike for acct=acme-int at 1976543002 (delta=13,742 tokens)
anita: Sorry about that — can you confirm which API key/environment the job uses?
sam-acme: prod API key (we keep nightly ingest on prod key for historical reasons). Job calls /v1/rerank with batch size 100.
lior: Quick question — did you recently flip any model variants? Rerank can fallback to different models if a variant is unavailable.
sam-acme: Not on our side. We did push a small change to the job two days ago (adjusted timeout), but no model config changes.
anita: Ok. Can you grab one of the failing job logs and paste the request headers (no secrets) so we can inspect idempotency usage?
sam-acme: paste: ```
POST /v1/rerank
Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**
Content-Type: application/json
User-Agent: acme-reranker/1.2.3
```
no Idempotency-Key header.
lior: That stands out — without Idempotency-Key our SDKs will retry on 5xx and some transient errors, and background cron systems often do naive retries too. If the retry retriggers the request it can double/quadruple token usage.
lior: Checking internal routing logs for acct=acme-int...
lior: Found it: between 1976542920 and 1976543050 we routed ~8 rerank requests that all expanded to a higher-token model variant (rerank-v2-large) due to a canary rollout. r_psq=8 duplicate submits observed because of repeated 502 responses and the client retried without idempotency.
lior: Each rerank call here is ~1.7k tokens because v2-large uses longer context scoring weights = cost ~2.1x of previous model. 8 duplicates * 1.7k = ~13.6k tokens — matches spike.
anita: Thanks, that explains the math. Sam, do you control the cron retry logic? Is it exponential backoff or fixed 3 attempts?
sam-acme: It's 3 attempts fixed with no dedupe. We assumed idempotency keys were handled by our wrapper but apparently not for rerank.
maya: From billing side — we can issue a one-off credit for the accidental duplicate usage while we investigate. I'll need a short write-up and the token counts to approve.
anita: We'll prepare the write-up. Meanwhile, two quick mitigation actions: 1) add require Idempotency-Key in our docs and server-side warn (low friction), 2) add temporary account-level soft cap for high-cost model variants in Dedicated/Hosted so background jobs can't accidentally route to more expensive variants.
lior: I can push a short-term server-side heuristic to prefer the cheaper compatible variant for accounts flagged as "background-batch" for the next 48 hours. Also adding explicit 4xx if Idempotency-Key missing AND retries likely (so clients get immediate failure and can fix).
anita: Can you also link the exact request IDs we saw? Need them for the support ticket.
lior: Request IDs: req_01A9X2, req_01A9X3, req_01A9X4, req_01A9X5, req_01A9X6, req_01A9X7, req_01A9X8, req_01A9X9 (1976542928..1976543048).
monitoring-bot: Note: rate-limit-normalization job triggered at 1976543100 for acct=acme-int (soft cap applied).
anita: Maya — summary for credit refund: account acme-int, window 1976542920-1976543050, duplicate rerank duplicates x8, approximate 13,742 tokens over normal usage. Can you process a promo credit equal to 14k tokens?
maya: I can do a one-time trial-credit grant of 14,000 tokens. Will mark as "investigation refunded". Processing now — expect visible in UI in ~15min.
sam-acme: Really appreciate the quick response. We'll patch our cron to include Idempotency-Key and reduce batch size for now.
lior: For reproducibility: steps we used to reproduce locally -> 1) toggle canary-rollout to prefer rerank-v2-large 2) send same rerank request multiple times without Idempotency-Key while returning intermittent 502 -> observe multiple successful downstream scores consuming tokens. Example curl we used to repro: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"queries":[...],"candidates":[...]}'
```
(no Idempotency-Key)
lior: Follow-ups: I will: (A) add server-side soft-preference for cheaper variant for background flagged accounts (deployed), (B) add a warning header response when no Idempotency-Key and retries seen (PR submitted), (C) add a doc snippet to support quick fix.
anita: Support action items: confirm UI credit applied, advise customer to add Idempotency-Key and reduce batch size.
maya: Credit applied: promo:INVEST-197654-14k visible on account acme-int.
sam-acme: Confirmed promo is visible, balance back to expected. Thanks team :tada: 
anita: Closing after 24h if no further anomalies. If you want a postmortem email, we can prepare one.
sam-acme: A short postmortem please — helps us patch our cron too.
lior: Will draft a short blameless postmortem and link internal PRs.
ops-bot: Thread archived by anita at 1976543699"
